title: Skip counting to learn times tables
examples: How do I count in fives?
How does skip counting help with times tables?

explain.say: Imagine a frog that only lands on every second lily pad. Hop, hop, hop! That is skip counting. Look at the number line on the board: two, four, six, eight, ten, and on.

draw.text: Skip counting to learn times tables

explain.say: Count the hops: five hops of two land on ten. That means five twos are ten! Skip counting is times tables in disguise. Can you hop five times with me?
Now count in fives: five, ten, fifteen, twenty, all the way to fifty. Clap on each number. Fives always end in 5 or 0. Can you hear the pattern?
Counting in tens is the quickest: ten, twenty, thirty, forty, fifty. Big frog jumps! Every number ends in zero. Can you stamp on each ten?
So what is three fives? Three hops of five: five, ten, fifteen. Three times five is fifteen! You just used skip counting to multiply. Fantastic! Challenge: count in twos as you climb the stairs.

faq.a: Skip counting means counting in jumps of the same size, like two, four, six, or five, ten, fifteen.

faq.q: How does skip counting help with times tables?
faq.a: Each hop is one group. Three hops of five land on fifteen, so three times five is fifteen.
asks: How do I use skip counting to multiply?

faq.q: How do I keep track of how many hops?
faq.a: Hold up one finger for each hop. When the right number of fingers is up, the number you just said is the answer.
asks: How do I count my hops?

faq.q: What patterns help me skip count?
faq.a: Twos are all even numbers. Fives end in five or zero. Tens always end in zero.

faq.q: How can I practise skip counting?
faq.a: Count in twos while climbing stairs, clap in fives, or sing the numbers to a tune you like. A teacher or grown-up can count with you.

facts: Counting in 5s from zero always gives numbers ending in 5 or 0.
Three hops of 5 on a number line land on 15, because 3 × 5 = 15.

quiz.why: Counting in fives, fifteen and five more is twenty.

wrong.1: Sixteen is only one more. Skip counting in fives jumps five.
wrong.2: Twenty-five comes after twenty, so you skipped one.

quiz.say: Four hops of 2 land on which number?
quiz.why: Two, four, six, eight: four hops of two land on eight.

wrong.1: Six is three hops of two.
wrong.2: Four is two hops of two.
